final_candidates.decision_summary: This Arg lies in the large extracellular loop implicated in substrate recognition; the corresponding Cys substitution (well-known reduced-function allele) abolishes most transport while surface expression and folding are largely maintained. Note: in the provided sequence the Arg is at position 60 (position 61 is Cys), so R60C is the residue-correct citation.

stop_reason.detail: Top-3 are established loss-of-function variants with retained expression; no external evidence available, so additional self-iteration would not change the ranking.
